products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare industry. The company was formerly known as Watson Health and now operates as Merative, offering a range of products aimed at healthcare providers, life sciences organizations, and payers.

Its product portfolio includes Micromedex, a clinical decision support solution delivering drug and clinical information at the point of care; Zelta, a cloud-based unified clinical data management and acquisition platform designed for clinical trials; and the Merge suite of enterprise imaging and workflow tools, which encompasses Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo recognized as 2025 Best in KLAS. Truven is also part of the portfolio, providing health data analytics and consulting services, and the company offers a separate real-world evidence data and services offering.

The site's held facts classify Merative under Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, noting its work in healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the available data.
